title: Verify Technician can create a new work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Technician role. (Tech View users can create new lines).
At least one work order exists.
steps:
1. Open the work order.
2. Click the option to add a new line.
3. Enter a line description and save.
expected: The new line is created successfully and appears on the work order.
